items.title: Gross margin
items.body: Of every ₦100 you sell, ₦30 is left after paying for the goods.

items.title: Net margin
items.body: After running costs you keep about ₦15.60 of every ₦100 you sell. 2 entries are not posted yet: expect about 9% when they are.

pill.text: Needs a look: +12% vs last year

items.body: Winning a new customer cost about ₦18,400 this year. Online shop customers cost the least.

items.title: Customer lifetime value
items.body: A customer typically spends ₦642,000 with you: 35 times what it costs to win them. Estimated from 14 months of history.

items.title: Cash runway
items.body: If no money came in, your cash would cover your costs until about 10 January.

items.title: Cash cycle

pill.text: Needs a look: +4 days vs September

items.body: Stock sits 24 days, customers pay in 31, suppliers wait 17. Slower customers added the 4 days.

items.title: General expenses are up 86% on the same days last month
items.body: Most of it is one bill: ₦210,000 for generator repairs on 14 October.

items.title: Online shop customers cost a quarter as much to win as paid advertising
items.body: ₦6,200 each against ₦24,900. Moving ₦200,000 of spend would win about 25 more customers a month.

items.title: Kite Market Co. has not ordered for 21 days; they usually order every 7
